gbm_population_evidence.quote: A confirmed histological diagnosis of high-grade diffuse glioma according to WHO 2021 criteria
diffuse glioma, NEC, grade 3-4; or glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype, grade 4
BM of solid tumour, including all primary tumour types

candidate_evidence.quote: This phase III multicenter, open-label, randomized clinical trial compares the clinical efficacy of first-line bevacizumab versus standard-of-care dexamethasone for sCRN in patients with high-grade glioma (HGG) or BM.
A clear working diagnosis of CRN without evidence of a combination with tumour progression is required

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: First episode of sCRN ≥ 3 months after completion of focal (re-)irradiation, as determined by the local Multidisciplinary Neuro-Oncology Board.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Pharmacokinetics bevacizumab and dexamethasone: Bevacizumab and dexamethasone serum and plasma concentrations pre- and post-dose

role_evidence.quote: Bevacizumab Versus Corticosteroids as First-line Treatment in Patients With Symptomatic Cerebral Radiation Necrosis After Radiation for High-grade Glioma or Brain Metastases
A small randomized clinical trial (RCT) has shown that bevacizumab significantly diminishes cerebral edema on MRI and decreases clinical symptoms of sCRN in irradiated glioma patients.

agents.drug_class_hint: anti-VEGF monoclonal antibody (established GBM therapy), used here for radiation necrosis

role_evidence.quote: [ACTIVE_COMPARATOR] Dexamethasone: Daily oral dexamethasone followed by a protocol-based tapering dose over 12 weeks
Patients in the intervention (bevacizumab) arm may use dexamethasone concurrently with bevacizumab if clinically indicated.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: Olink Target 96 immuno-oncology blood protein panel

source_quote.quote: Immuno-oncology proteins as blood-based biomarkers for (early) treatment response in both treatment arms using Olink Target 96 Immuno-oncology panel
Platelet RNA profiles as blood-based biomarkers for (early) treatment response in both treatment arms

coder_notes: Trial treats symptomatic cerebral radiation necrosis (not the tumour) in HGG (WHO 2021 incl. glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype) and brain-metastasis patients. Bevacizumab coded supportive (stated purpose: oedema/symptom control of sCRN; tumour PFS/RANO are secondary outcomes only). Alternative coding would be established_therapy_experiment (bevacizumab in new setting); either way no candidate, but exclusion reason could then be established_therapy_only. Dexamethasone is the active comparator and also allowed in the experimental arm; coded supportive (symptom control in both arms) rather than control_comparator. Treatment setting relative to GBM disease course not stated (post-irradiation), coded unclear. IDH and 1p/19q appear only as WHO 2021 diagnostic categories, not entry requirements, so not listed as biomarkers. PK is serum/plasma only.
